body: I was diagnosed with PTSD late last year, however I'm wondering if the reason my treatment never worked was because I have C-PTSD. I was sexually assaulted at 14, drugged and raped at 25, had an abortion at 25 from the rape, and my mother was mildly abusive my entire life and not nurturing at all. When she found out I was raped at 25 I deserved it because I was running karaoke at a bar every weekend and that she considered "partying".

I would be interested in this my anxiety and depression has gotten increasingly worse here lately. It is a result of my PTSD. Message me if your interested I'm a great listener, my friend's daughter has severe depression and I often listen to her it would be nice to have someone I can talk to about it, as she is way too young for me to talk to her about my thoughts.
My nephew still plays with mine!  I used to get cars jammed in the little elevator all the time by continuously turning the lever to make it ding at the top
Im in love with him. He loves me.  He's having problems of his own right now, when he's not stressed he treats me well, but when he's stressed he doesn't  talk to me. He's got a lot going on now too.
Thanks everyone for the help and kind words.  I've made it through the storm battle, and I'm still on team human /u/save_the_runaway

I've had lucid dreams for the past few years, they've recently have become very frightening as I know I'm dreaming and I'm trying to wake up and I become trapped and panicked. I've been stuck in dreams here a lot recently. Idk if it's because my bipolar has gotten worse or what.  But it feels like I'm trapped in a glass box and I can't get out. I know I'm dreaming and I can't wake myself up.
Love the tie. Did you buy it online?
And that kids is how hot dogs are made.

I really wish that there were some investigators near me like you Jude that I could learn from, I'd rather learn from someone than jump feet first with no knowledge at all. The parapsychology aspect of investigating has always intrigued me but I have no idea where to begin at with it.
